User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated user profile with saved payment defaults and favorite sale IDs.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

name.description: Display name shown on the user's profile.

email.description: User email address stored strictly in their private profile.

payments.description: Default payment method IDs accepted by the seller.

savedIds.description: Sale IDs bookmarked by the user.

listingOrder.description: Custom display order of sale IDs posted by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: A public garage, yard, estate, or car boot sale listing.

address.description: Public street address of the sale.

saleType.description: Type of sale event (Garage Sale, Flea Market, or Car Boot Sale).

cats.description: Category labels associated with the sale.

items.description: Notable items available at the sale.

prices.description: Optional map of item name to numeric price.

food.description: Whether food is offered at the sale.

drinks.description: Whether drinks or lemonade are offered at the sale.

photos.description: Up to 4 compressed JPEG data URLs or photo paths.

desc.description: Optional sale highlights and parking notes.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the seller who posted the sale.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale was posted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles storing seller payment defaults and bookmarked sales.

/sales/{saleId}.description: Public community garage, yard, and car boot sale listings.
